text: In a small Pennsylvania town, teenagers Steve and Jane see [a meteorite crash beyond the hill|origin|from another world], and an old man who pokes it is swallowed by the jelly inside. The Blob [grows redder and larger with every person it absorbs|wants|feeding on the living], oozing through a doctor's office, a grocery store and a midnight picture show. Nobody listens to Steve until [the cinema empties in screaming panic|who_suffers|whole communities], and his only clue is that [the thing shrinks from the cold|rules|it has a fatal weakness].
